title: operad bot settings
description: The `bot` section of config.json, owned by the bot plugin.

bots.description: The bots, by name. `default` exists even when it is not written here.

cwd.description: The working directory. Without it: ~/.operad/bot for `default`, ~/.operad/bot/<name> for any other. It must be inside ~/.operad/bot or outside the operad home.

harness.description: The harness a new chat uses when it names none.

skills.description: Directories with a SKILL.md, given to the agent at every reply. A relative path is under the working directory.

speaker.description: How a chat of this bot labels the model's messages in its transcript. Without it the chat plugin's speaker is used.

mcpServers.description: The local MCP servers this bot's chats mount, by name. A server is added only through `bot mcp`, which a person approves; the digest is of its tool names and descriptions, and a chat that finds other tools does not mount the server.

command.description: The program that starts the server.

package.description: The package the command runs, when it runs one.

version.description: The pinned version of that package.

secrets.description: Environment variables the server needs. Each value is the bot plugin's secret `<server>.<variable>`, given to the server only when it starts.

tools.description: The tools the server offered when a person approved it.

digest.description: The digest of the tool names and descriptions.

mcpAllow.description: MCP tools that run without asking, as `<server>.<tool>` or `<server>.*`. A tool not listed counts as a write and asks first.

access.description: Added to the default access profile: the lists are appended and readOnly can be turned on. A bot can tighten the default, never loosen it.
